features: Dual Mode ONU with Advanced Features: Plug and play functionality with auto-detecting, auto-configuration, and auto firmware upgrade capabilities for seamless installation and operation
Integrated Remote Management: OAM remote configuration and maintenance function enables efficient network management and troubleshooting from a centralized location
Advanced VLAN and Multicast Support: Rich QinQ VLAN functions and IGMP Snooping multicast features ensure efficient network segmentation and multimedia streaming capabilities
High-Speed Connectivity: Features 1 PON port and 1 Gigabit Ethernet port for ultra-broadband FTTH access suitable for home and SOHO environments

Enhanced Security and Performance: Built-in NAT and Firewall functions provide network security while ensuring guaranteed Quality of Service compliant with IEEE 802.3ah EPON and ITU-T G.984.x GPON standards
description: DIGISOL DG-GR6010 is a Dual Mode Routing ONU modem designed for fulfilling FTTH ultra-broadband access request of home and SOHO users. It supports NAT/Firewall functions. It is based on the stable and mature EPON/GPON technology, which has high performance to price ratio. It is highly reliable and easy to maintain, with guaranteed QoS and fully compliant to IEEE 802.3ah EPON and ITU-T G.984.x GPON standard.
